dialogues.jp: なんだか懐かしい夢を見てしまった。
dialogues.en: I had a dream about something deep in my memory.
dialogues.text: I had a dream about something deep in my memory.

dialogues.jp:
従姉で……幼なじみの……女の子との別れの日
の夢。
dialogues.en: A dream about the day my cousin, and childhood friend, left.
dialogues.text: A dream about the day my cousin, and childhood friend, left.

dialogues.jp:
昨日に引き続き２日連続――いったいどうした
んだろう？
dialogues.en:
I've had this sort of dream for two days in a row now...
what's going on?
dialogues.text:
I've had this sort of dream for two days in a row now...
what's going on?

dialogues.jp:
遠くで街のざわめきが聞こえる。｛まぶた／瞼｝の外に光を
感じる。まどろみの中をさまよいつつも、いつ
でも起きれそうな、そんな感覚が続いている。
dialogues.en:
I could hear the noisy chatter of the street outside, the
sunlight on my eyelids. I felt I wouldn't be able to fall
asleep again.
dialogues.text:
I could hear the noisy chatter of the street outside, the
sunlight on my eyelids. I felt I wouldn't be able to fall
asleep again.

dialogues.jp:
週に一度の貴重な休日……とことん、だれてい
たい。
dialogues.en:
On the only day of the week which can be used for rest...
it'd be a shame not to use it.
dialogues.text:
On the only day of the week which can be used for rest...
it'd be a shame not to use it.

dialogues.jp: もうそろそろ、起きるか？

dialogues.en: Sunday awaited me after waking up from a bittersweet dream.
dialogues.text: Sunday awaited me after waking up from a bittersweet dream.

dialogues.jp:
懐かしい夢から目覚めると、日曜が俺を待って
いた。
dialogues.en: To get up, or to try to sleep again...
dialogues.text: To get up, or to try to sleep again...

dialogues.jp:
起きるべきか……もう一度眠るべきか――
――それが問題だ。
